label: early copy steps (outputs 1-2) of long sequences
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase, never on original or delimiter steps. It is concentrated on the first two copy-phase inputs (recall_idx 1-2, so the input is original token 0 or 1 being fed back; about 92% of mass), with a little at recall_idx 3. The rate rises steeply with sequence length (L=9 has 53% of mass; L<=5 almost none), so it effectively tracks being early in a long copy (to_go 5-7). Within that window, firing depends heavily on which token is input: w, m, a, 0 and u fire most often and hardest (the top activations are mostly w or a fed back right after <DEL>), and many other tokens do not fire at all. That token dependence is why precision is about 0.5. The largest activations are at recall_idx 1, the first fed-back token. It does not fire on the first occurrence of a token (in_first=1), on late copy steps, or on short sequences.
